verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Qad aflahal-mu'minoon
Al-ladheena hum fee salaatihim khaashi'oon
Wal-ladheena hum anil-laghwi mu'ridoon
Wal-ladheena hum liz-zakaati fa-iloon
Wal-ladheena hum lifuroojihim haafizoon
Illaa alaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fa-innahum ghayru maloomeen
Famani ibtaghaa waraa'a dhaalika fa-ulaa'ika humul-aadoon
Wal-ladheena hum li'maanaatihim wa ahdihim raa'oon
Wal-ladheena hum alaa salawaatihim yuhaafizoon
Ulaa'ika humul-waarithoon
Al-ladheena yarithoonal-firdawsa hum feehaa khaalidoon
Wa laqad khalaqnal-insaana min sulaalatin min teen
Thumma ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarin makeen
Thumma khalaqnan-nutfata alaqatan fakhalaqnal-alaqata mudghatan fakhalaqnal-mudghata izaaman fakasawnal-izaama lahman thumma ansha'naahu khalqan aakhara fatabaaraka Allaahu ahsanul-khaaliqeen
Thumma innakum ba'da dhaalika lamayyitoon
Thumma innakum yawmal-qiyaamati tub'athoon
Wa laqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraa'iqa wa maa kunnaa anil-khalqi ghaafileen
Wa anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an biqadarin fa-askannaahu fil-ardi wa innaa alaa dhahaabin bihi laqaadiroon
Fa-ansha'naa lakum bihi jannaatin min nakheelin wa a'naabin lakum feehaa fawaakihu katheeratun wa minhaa ta'kuloon
Wa shajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa'a tanbutu bid-duhni wa sibghin lil-aakileen
Wa inna lakum fil-an'aami la-ibratan nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u katheeratun wa minhaa ta'kuloon
Wa alayhaa wa alal-fulki tuhmaloon
Wa laqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihi faqaala yaa qawmi u'budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu afalaa tattaqoon

Faqaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihi maa haadhaa illaa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala alaykum wa law shaa'a Allaahu la-anzala malaa'ikatan maa sami'naa bihadhaa fee aabaa'inal-awwaleen
In huwa illaa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hattaa heen
Qaala rabbi unsurnee bimaa kadhdhaboon

Fa-awhaynaa ilayhi anis-na'il-fulka bi-a'yuninaa wa wahyinaa fa-idhaa jaa'a amrunaa wa faarat-tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjayni ithnayni wa ahlaka illaa man sabaqa alayhil-qawlu minhum wa laa tukhaatibnee fil-ladheena zalamoo innahum mughraqoon
Fa-idhaa istawayta anta wa man ma'aka alal-fulki faqulil-hamdu Lillaahil-ladhee najjaanaa minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wa qul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubaarakan wa anta khayrul-munzileen
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin wa in kunnaa lamubtaleen
Thumma ansha'naa min ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen
Fa-arsalnaa feehim rasoolan minhum ani-budoo Allaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruhu afalaa tattaqoon

Wa qaalal-mala'u min qawmihil-ladheena kafaroo wa kadhdhaboo biliqaa'il-aakhirati wa atrafnaahum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa maa haadhaa illaa basharun mithlukum ya'kulu mimmaa ta'kuloona minhu wa yashrabu mimmaa tashraboon
Wa la-in ata'tum basharan mithlakum innakum idhan lakhaasiroon
Aya'idukum annakum idhaa mittum wa kuntum turaaban wa izaaman annakum mukhrajoon
Hayhaata hayhaata limaa too'adoon
In hiya illaa hayaatunad-dunyaa namootu wa nahyaa wa maa nahnu bimab'ootheen
In huwa illaa rajulun iftaraa alaa Allaahi kadhiban wa maa nahnu lahu bimu'mineen
Qaala rabbi unsurnee bimaa kadhdhaboon
Qaala ammaa qaleelin layusbihunna naadimeen
Fa-akhadhathumus-sayhatu bil-haqqi faja'alnaahum ghuthaa'an fabu'dan lilqawmiz-zaalimeen
Thumma ansha'naa min ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen
Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yasta'khiroon
Thumma arsalnaa rusulanaa tatraa kulla maa jaa'a ummatan rasooluhaa kadhdhaboohu fa-atba'naa ba'dahum ba'dan wa ja'alnaahum ahaadeetha fabu'dan liqawmin laa yu'minoon
Thumma arsalnaa moosaa wa akhaahu haaroona bi-aayaatinaa wa sultaanin mubeen
Ilaa fir'awna wa mala'ihi fastakbaroo wa kaanoo qawman aaleen
Faqaaloo anu'minu libasharayni mithlinaa wa qawmuhumaa lanaa aabidoon
Fakadhdhaboohumaa fakaanoo minal-muhlakeen
Wa laqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba la-allahum yahtadoon
Wa ja'alnaa ibna maryama wa ummahu aayatan wa aawaynaahumaa ilaa rabwatin dhaati qaraarin wa ma'een
Yaa ayyuhar-rusulu kuloo minat-tayyibaati wa'maloo saalihan innee bimaa ta'maloona aleem
Wa inna haadhihi ummatukum ummatan waahidatan wa anaa rabbukum fattaqoon
Fataqatta'oo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bimaa ladayhim farihoon
Fadharhum fee ghamratihim hattaa heen
Ayahsaboona annamaa numidduhum bihi min maalin wa baneen
Nusaari'u lahum fil-khayraati bal laa yash'uroon
Innal-ladheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoon
Wal-ladheena hum bi-aayaati rabbihim yu'minoon
Wal-ladheena hum birabbihim laa yushrikoon
Wal-ladheena yu'toona maa aataw wa quloobuhum wa jilatun annahum ilaa rabbihim raaji'oon
Ulaa'ika yusaari'oona fil-khayraati wa hum lahaa saabiqoon
Wa laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa wa ladaynaa kitaabun yantiqu bil-haqqi wa hum laa yuzlamoon
Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min haadhaa wa lahum a'maalun min dooni dhaalika hum lahaa aamiloon
Hattaa idhaa akhadhnaa mutrafeehim bil-adhaabi idhaa hum yaj'aroon
Laa taj'arul-yawma innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon
Qad kaanat aayaatee tutlaa alaykum fakuntum alaa a'qaabikum tankisoon
Mustakbireena bihi saamiran tahjuroon
Afalam yaddabbarul-qawla am jaa'ahum maa lam ya'ti aabaa'ahumul-awwaleen
Am lam ya'rifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroon
Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaa'ahum bil-haqqi wa aktharuhum lilhaqqi kaarihoon
Wa lawit-taba'al-haqqu ahwaa'ahum lafasadatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu wa man feehinna bal ataynaahum bidhikrihim fahum an dhikrihim mu'ridoon
Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju rabbika khayrun wa huwa khayrur-raaziqeen
Wa innaka latad'oohum ilaa siraatin mustaqeem
Wa innal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati anis-siraati lanaakiboon
Wa law rahimnaahum wa kashafnaa maa bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
Wa laqad akhadhnaahum bil-adhaabi famas-takaanoo lirabbihim wa maa yatadarra'oon
Hattaa idhaa fatahnaa alayhim baaban dhaa adhaabin shadeedin idhaa hum feehi mublisoon
Wa huwal-ladhee ansha'a lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata qaleelan maa tashkuroon
Wa huwal-ladhee dhara'akum fil-ardi wa ilayhi tuhsharoon
Wa huwal-ladhee yuhyee wa yumeetu wa lahukh-tilaaful-layli wan-nahaari afalaa ta'qiloon
Bal qaaloo mithla maa qaalal-awwaloon
Qaaloo a'idhaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban wa izaaman a'innaa lamab'oothoon
Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa aabaa'uunaa haadhaa min qablu in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
Qul limanil-ardu wa man feehaa in kuntum ta'lamoon
Sayaqooloona Lillaahi qul afalaa tadhakkaroon
Qul man rabbus-samaawaatis-sab'i wa rabbul-arshil-azeem
Sayaqooloona Lillaahi qul afalaa tattaqoon
Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shay'in wa huwa yujeeru wa laa yujaaru alayhi in kuntum ta'lamoon
Sayaqooloona Lillaahi qul fa-annaa tusharoon
Bal ataynaahum bil-haqqi wa innahum lakaadhiboon
Mat-takhadha Allaahu min waladin wa maa kaana ma'ahu min ilaahin idhan ladhahaba kullu ilaahin bimaa khalaqa wa la-alaa ba'duhum alaa ba'din subhaanallaahi ammaa yasifoon
Aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fata'aalaa ammaa yushrikoon
Qul rabbi immaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon
Rabbi falaa taj'alnee fil-qawmiz-zaalimeen
Wa innaa alaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon
Idfa billatee hiya ahsanus-sayyi'ata nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon
Wa qul rabbi a'oodhu bika min hamazaatish-shayaateen
Wa a'oodhu bika rabbi an yahduroon
Hattaa idhaa jaa'a ahadahumul-mawtu qaala rabbi irji'oon
La-allee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa innahaa kalimatun huwa qaa'iluhaa wa min waraa'ihim barzakhun ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
Fa-idhaa nufikha fis-soori falaa ansaaba baynahum yawma'idhin wa laa yatasaa'aloon
Faman thaqulat mawaazeenuhu fa-ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
Wa man khaffat mawaazeenuhu fa-ulaa'ikal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khaalidoon
Talfahu wujoohahumun-naaru wa hum feehaa kaalihoon
Alam takun aayaatee tutlaa alaykum fakuntum bihaa tukadhdhiboon
Qaaloo rabbanaa ghalabat alaynaa shiqwatunaa wa kunnaa qawman daalleen
Rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa-in udnaa fa-innaa zaalimoon
Qaalakh-sa'oo feehaa wa laa tukallimoon
Innahu kaana fareequn min ibaadee yaqooloona rabbanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa anta khayrur-raahimeen
Fattakhadhtumoohum sikhriyyan hattaa ansawkum dhikree wa kuntum minhum tadhakoon
Innee jazaytuhumul-yawma bimaa sabaroo annahum humul-faa'izoon
Qaala kam labithtum fil-ardi adada sineen
Qaaloo labithnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin faas'alil-aaddeen
Qaala in labithtum illaa qaleelan law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon
Afahasibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum abathan wa annakum ilaynaa laa turja'oon
Fata'aalaa Allaahul-malikul-haqqu laa ilaaha illaa huwa rabbul-arshil-kareem
Wa man yad'u ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara laa burhaana lahu bihi fa-innamaa hisaabuhu inda rabbihi innahu laa yuflihul-kaafiroon
Wa qul rabbi ighfir warham wa anta khayrur-raahimeen
